title: Whether the deliberate public buy may use a new nonce after a private attempt

options.name: Keep current behaviour
options.risk: If a private attempt lands after the not-landed guard and before the public send, the public buy takes the next nonce and buys a second time (AUD-BUY-030).

options.name: Send the public buy on the private attempt nonce
options.behavior_impact: The public buy can only replace the private attempt, so at most one of them lands.
options.risk: The public fee must exceed the private bid by the node replacement bump, or the public send is refused.

options.name: Wait until the private attempt can no longer land
options.behavior_impact: The fallback starts later, after the last targeted block passes.
options.risk: A slower fallback on a time-sensitive buy.

default: Keep current behaviour until the owning phase decides (milestone contract); S1 candidate pending the Phase 23 reproduction attempt.
behavior_impact: Decides whether the operator deliberate buy can buy twice.
